name: ledger_duplicate_amount_bug
requirements: Ledger.apply_charge must apply each event_id at most once, even when a replay uses a DIFFERENT amount; first-write wins, distinct event IDs remain independent.
oracle:
l=Ledger()
l.apply_charge("evt1",7)
l.apply_charge("evt1",99)
l.apply_charge("evt2",5)
l.apply_charge("evt2",5)
assert l.entries==[("evt1",7),("evt2",5)]
assert l.total==12

name: canonical_id_bug
requirements: Exported public account IDs MUST follow the established canonical_account_id contract: trim, lowercase, and prefix acct_ if missing. Reuse the helper; don't substitute partial normalization.
